summary: Distinct Hero Gate authority invariant gap: PhysicsLabStudioHarness can own a canonical RealizedLab under an arbitrary server-side parent even though the permanent Physics Lab contract and two-client evidence boundary require Workspace/UNRENDERED_PhysicsLab as the replicated physical truth. start(parent) forwards any non-nil Instance to PhysicsLabRealizer.realize and restart(parent) preserves that caller-selected parent. The private two-client driver fails closed if the existing harness handle is not represented as exactly one Workspace root, so this is not a false-PASS vulnerability; it is a source-contract/evidence-readiness gap that can leave server authority valid while clients cannot observe it. Do not open a competing authority implementation while #316/#307/#300 are active. After that completion train lands, fold a narrow replicated-parent invariant into HG-BACKFILL-AUTHORITY or schedule a bounded follow-up: Studio harness start/restart should either require Workspace or explicitly separate test-only arbitrary-parent realization from the canonical harness, with a pure regression proving the canonical handle cannot be acquired outside Workspace. No Studio evidence is claimed.
evidence: Docs/PHYSICS_LAB.md defines src/server/PhysicsLab/PhysicsLabRealizer.luau as realizing the recipe into Workspace/UNRENDERED_PhysicsLab.

Current main PhysicsLabStudioHarness.start(parent) calls PhysicsLabRealizer.realize(parent or workspace); restart(parent) calls stop() and then start(parent), so ServerStorage or another non-Workspace parent is accepted by the canonical harness API.

default.project.json enables Workspace streaming and maps server code under ServerScriptService; the multiplayer proof therefore depends on a replicated Workspace representation rather than an arbitrary server-only parent.

The private physics-lab-two-client driver uses Harness.get() if a handle already exists, then separately asserts exactly one Workspace/UNRENDERED_PhysicsLab root and waits for two client observations. An off-Workspace canonical handle therefore causes fail-closed evidence failure rather than automatic normalization.

Active PR #307 regression-locks the current parent-or-workspace/start(parent) lifecycle shape; PR #316 only repairs bootstrap pre-dependency context ordering and PR #300 only locks Rojo deployment separation. None establishes the missing canonical Workspace-parent invariant.
